items.source:
Cache statistics for a RedisCache.
NOTE: CacheStatistics only serve local (in memory) data and do not collect any server statistics.
items.translation:
RedisCache 的缓存统计信息。
注意：CacheStatistics仅提供本地（内存）数据，不收集任何服务器统计信息。

items.source: the number of gets that have not yet been answered (neither hit nor miss).
items.translation: 尚未得到答复（既非hit也非miss）的gets数量。

items.source: the total number of get operations including both hits and misses.
items.translation: 包括hits和misses在内的总获取操作次数。

items.source: the name of the RedisCache.
items.translation: 名为RedisCache的类。

items.source: lock duration using the given TimeUnit if the cache is configured to use locking.
items.translation: 如果缓存配置为使用锁定，则使用给定的 TimeUnit 来设置锁的持续时间。

items.source: instantaneous point in time of last statistics counter reset. Equals getSince() if never reset.
items.translation: 上次统计计数器重置的瞬时时间点。如果从未重置，则等于getSince()。

items.source: unit - the time unit to report the lock wait duration.
items.translation: unit - 用于报告锁等待持续时间的计时单位。

items.source: number of put operations on the cache.
items.translation: 缓存中的写入操作数量。

items.source: the number of cache get hits.
initial point in time when started statistics capturing.
items.translation: 开始统计捕获的初始时间点。
